panels.title: How to read this dashboard

options.content:
This dashboard separates **ext4/XFS host filesystem accounting**, **Piraeus thin-pool physical use**, and **per-copy allocation estimates**. They cover different layers; do not add them or expect the per-copy estimates to reconcile to pool physical use.

Piraeus `pool_used` and `pool_free` are physical measurements. `pool_committed` sums diskful PV capacity limits; commitment ratio is limits divided by raw pool capacity, not a physical-use percentage, and can exceed 100%. Uncommitted headroom is capacity minus limits and can be negative.

Per-copy rows include retained resources; resource name and PV phase identify copies without a current PVC. PVC filesystem-used is a separate kubelet measure on the consumer node, compared with a Bound PV capacity limit deduplicated across copies. Raw block PVCs have a limit but no filesystem-used value; unmounted and Released copies appear only in the copy section.

Machine filters node-owned panels. S3 bucket panels are cluster-wide because they lack storage-node ownership. Lower collector detail overlaps: SeaweedFS logical bucket bytes omit replicas; physical bucket bytes and collection bytes mostly measure the same replicated data. Missing samples do not imply zero use.

panels.title: Node filesystem used
panels.description: Sum of ext4/XFS filesystem size minus free bytes, deduplicated by node and device. This excludes ext4 root-reserved blocks and is host-filesystem accounting, separate from Piraeus thin-pool use.

panels.title: Node filesystem capacity
panels.description: Total ext4/XFS host filesystem capacity from filesystem recording rules, deduplicated by node and device.

panels.title: Piraeus thin pools
Physical pool used
panels.description: Piraeus thin-pool physical use, summed over the selected storage nodes and pools.

panels.title: Physical pool capacity
panels.description: Raw Piraeus thin-pool capacity. This is separate from ext4/XFS filesystem capacity.

panels.title: Physical pool free
panels.description: Piraeus thin-pool physical free bytes from the pool accounting rules.

panels.title: Diskful copy limits
panels.description: Sum of per-copy PV capacity limits committed on the selected pools; this is not physical use.

panels.title: Uncommitted limit headroom
panels.description: Raw pool capacity minus diskful copy capacity limits. This limit comparison may be negative; it is not physical free space.

panels.title: Copy limits / pool capacity
panels.description: Diskful PV capacity limits divided by raw pool capacity. This is not a physical-use percentage and can exceed 100%.

panels.title: Piraeus thin-pool physical use over time
panels.description: Physical bytes used and raw capacity per storage node and pool. These series do not include per-volume estimates or ext4/XFS host filesystem bytes.

panels.title: Diskful copy limits vs pool capacity over time
panels.description: PV capacity limits of diskful copies compared with raw pool capacity, per storage node and pool. These limits are not allocated bytes.

panels.title: Piraeus thin-pool accounting by storage node
panels.description: Physical capacity, used and free bytes are shown separately from the sum of diskful PV limits. Uncommitted headroom is capacity minus those limits and may be negative.

panels.title: Piraeus diskful volume copies
Estimated allocation per diskful copy
panels.description: Per-copy allocation estimates on each Piraeus storage node. Resource and PV phase labels keep retained or unidentified copies visible. These estimates are not a decomposition of pool physical use.

targets.expr: label_join(sum by (node, storage_pool, phase, resource, persistentvolume, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:volume_allocated_bytes{node=~"$node"}), "copy", " · ", "node", "storage_pool", "phase", "resource", "persistentvolume", "namespace", "persistentvolumeclaim")

panels.title: Diskful copy allocation estimates and PV limits
panels.description: One row per storage-node copy, including resources without a current PVC identity. Estimated allocation and PV capacity limit are separate values; phase distinguishes Bound, Released, and Available PVs.

targets.expr: sum by (node, storage_pool, phase, resource, persistentvolume, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:volume_allocated_bytes{node=~"$node"})
max by (node, storage_pool, phase, resource, persistentvolume, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:volume_capacity_bytes{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Piraeus PVC filesystem usage and capacity limits
Kubelet filesystem use and Bound Piraeus PVC limit
panels.description: Kubelet filesystem-used bytes and volume capacity limits for measured Bound Piraeus PVCs on the selected consumer nodes. Limits are deduplicated across diskful copies. Raw block PVCs and unmounted volumes have no filesystem-used sample; their limits remain visible in the diskful copy table above.

targets.expr: disk_usage:pvc_used_bytes{node=~"$node"} and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:volume_capacity_bytes{phase="Bound"})

group by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim, node) (disk_usage:pvc_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left () max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:volume_capacity_bytes{phase="Bound"})

(disk_usage:pvc_used_bytes{node=~"$node"} and on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:volume_capacity_bytes{phase="Bound"})) / on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left() max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:volume_capacity_bytes{phase="Bound"})

panels.title: Scraped ext4/XFS filesystem capacity by use
panels.description: Host filesystem components, unattributed use, root-only reserve, and available bytes. Piraeus thin-pool physical use and volume-copy estimates are separate accounting layers.

panels.title: Selected machines · ext4/XFS filesystem attribution
Node filesystem use by component
panels.description: One bar per scraped ext4/XFS filesystem across the selected machines, labelled node, device, mountpoint, and media. Bars share the largest selected disk as their scale. Components come from existing filesystem rules; Piraeus pool physical use and per-copy estimates are separate.

targets.expr: label_join((sum by (node, device, component) (disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) or label_replace(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Unattributed", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_free_bytes{node=~"$node"} - disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Reserved (root only)", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Free", "", "")) * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}), "disk", " · ", "node", "device", "mountpoint", "media")

panels.title: Per-collector detail
Node filesystem attribution details
panels.description: Ext4/XFS filesystem component estimates, free bytes, and root-only reserve by node and device. Piraeus thin-pool accounting is kept separate; per-copy Piraeus allocation estimates do not form a residual against these filesystem bytes.

targets.expr: sort_desc((sum by (node, device, component) (disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) or label_replace(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Unattributed", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_free_bytes{node=~"$node"} - disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Reserved (root only)", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Free", "", "")) * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}))

(sum by (node, device, component) (disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) or label_replace(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Unattributed", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_free_bytes{node=~"$node"} - disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Reserved (root only)", "", "") or label_replace(disk_usage:filesystem_avail_bytes{node=~"$node"}, "component", "Free", "", "")) * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}) / on (node, device) group_left () disk_usage:filesystem_size_bytes{node=~"$node"}

panels.title: Unattributed bytes per disk
panels.description: Filesystem used (size minus free) minus every attributed component. On system disks (/var, /) this is mostly container images, emptyDir volumes, logs and etcd, which no scraped metric breaks down; on data disks, see the PVC list beside it.

targets.expr: sort_desc(label_join(disk_usage:unattributed_bytes{node=~"$node"} * on (node, device) group_left (mountpoint, media) (topk by (node, device) (1, disk_usage:mount:info{node=~"$node"}) * on (node, device) group_left (media) disk_usage:filesystem:info{node=~"$node"}), "disk", " · ", "node", "device", "mountpoint", "media"))

panels.title: Node-local PVCs with no filesystem size attribution
panels.description: PVCs visible in the existing node-local filesystem mapping but without a matching component-size sample. This is an ext4/XFS mapping detail, separate from Piraeus copy allocation and kubelet PVC use below.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, device, namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (disk_usage:pvc_filesystem:info{node=~"$node"} unless on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) disk_usage:component_used_bytes{node=~"$node"}) * on (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) group_left () max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (kube_persistentvolumeclaim_resource_requests_storage_bytes))

panels.title: Node filesystem used now
panels.description: Ext4/XFS size minus filesystem free bytes on the selected machine. Free bytes include root-reserved blocks, so the reported used bytes exclude that reserve.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, device, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!="",device!~"/dev/drbd.*"} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!="",device!~"/dev/drbd.*"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Largest node filesystems over time
panels.description: Ext4/XFS size minus filesystem free bytes on the selected machine. Free bytes include root-reserved blocks, so the reported used bytes exclude that reserve.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (node, device, mountpoint) ((node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!="",device!~"/dev/drbd.*"} - node_filesystem_free_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs",device!="",device!~"/dev/drbd.*"}) * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="monitoring",pod=~"prometheus-node-exporter-.+",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: CNPG database size by machine now
panels.description: CNPG exporter database-size values from pods on the selected machine. This database metric is not total PGDATA filesystem use; replicas report their own copies and must not be added across machines as unique data.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, namespace, job, datname) (cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes{datname!~"template0|template1"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: Largest CNPG databases by machine over time
panels.description: CNPG exporter database-size values from pods on the selected machine. This database metric is not total PGDATA filesystem use; replicas report their own copies and must not be added across machines as unique data.

targets.expr: topk(10, max by (node, namespace, job, datname) (cnpg_pg_database_size_bytes{datname!~"template0|template1"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: SeaweedFS volume-server disks by machine now
panels.description: Volume-server all/available/used resource gauges from pods on the selected machine. These per-server values are collector detail and are not additive to the filesystem or Piraeus pool totals.

targets.expr: sort_desc(max by (node, pod, name, type) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_resource{namespace="seaweedfs",type=~"all|avail|used"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"})))

panels.title: SeaweedFS volume-server disk use by machine over time
panels.description: Volume-server reported used bytes per selected storage node and server disk. This is a per-collector view; do not add it to the independent pool and filesystem accounting layers.

targets.expr: max by (node, pod, name) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_resource{namespace="seaweedfs",type="used"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 logical bucket size now (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Logical S3 object bytes by bucket across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership.

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS S3 logical buckets over time (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Logical S3 object bytes by bucket across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership; logical bytes omit replicas.

panels.title: SeaweedFS S3 physical bucket size now (cluster-wide)
panels.description: S3-reported physical bucket bytes across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership.

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS S3 physical buckets over time (cluster-wide)
panels.description: S3-reported physical bucket bytes across the cluster. The Machine selector does not apply because this metric has no storage-node ownership; these overlap with collection-level replica bytes.

panels.title: SeaweedFS collection bytes by machine now
panels.description: Collection bytes reported by volume-server pods on the selected machine. Each replica is counted on its storage node; these collector values overlap physical bucket bytes.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (node, collection) (max by (node, collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_total_disk_size{namespace="seaweedfs",type="normal",collection!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: Largest SeaweedFS collections by machine over time
panels.description: Collection bytes reported by volume-server pods on the selected machine over time. Each replica is counted on its storage node; these collector values overlap physical bucket bytes.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (node, collection) (max by (node, collection, pod) (SeaweedFS_volumeServer_total_disk_size{namespace="seaweedfs",type="normal",collection!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="seaweedfs",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: ClickHouse MergeTree bytes by machine now
panels.description: MergeTree bytes reported by ClickHouse pods on the selected machine, including the existing system-table metric. This per-pod collector detail is separate from host filesystem and Piraeus pool use.

targets.expr: sort_desc((max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTables{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})) + max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTablesSystem{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"}))))

panels.title: ClickHouse MergeTree bytes by machine over time
panels.description: MergeTree bytes reported by ClickHouse pods on the selected machine, including the existing system-table metric. This per-pod collector detail is separate from host filesystem and Piraeus pool use.

targets.expr: (max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTables{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})) + max by (node, namespace, pod) (ClickHouseAsyncMetrics_TotalBytesOfMergeTreeTablesSystem{namespace="clickhouse"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) max by (namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{namespace="clickhouse",node=~"$node"})))
